title: Call For Applications: Research Associate | JSW Centre For The Future Of Law (JSW-CFL), NLSIU
description: The National Law School of India University (NLSIU) invites applications for a full-time role as a Research Associate at the Centre for the Future of Law at NLSIU based out of the University campus. This is a full-time role on contractual basis for a period of one year (extendable), based in Bengaluru.
